messages:
jess (PM): Heads-up — I'm kicking off an acceptance checklist thread for the Optimize toolkit pilot. Goal: clear launch gates for batching/caching/quant recs + eval-triggered alerts. Need quick triage of must-haves vs nice-to-haves.

raj (Eng): +1. can we align on what 'batching recs' actually surface? per-route suggestions, autoscale knobs, or both?

sarah (Eng): Real-world: customers want per-route batch size + target latency. I vote for MVP = static per-route suggestion + one-click enable for runtime.

lee (PM): Proposed MVP scope (short):
- Batching: per-route suggested batch sizes, expected latency delta, cost delta
- Caching: prefix cache for completions + hot-path KV hints
- Quant recs: model-agnostic quant profiles (FP16/INT8) with quality delta estimates
- Eval-alerts: thresholded regressions on a small prompt set, email + console alert
This keeps rollout finite.

anya (Solutions): Customers A/B asked for: explicit canary rollback if quant recs degrade quality, and per-customer opt-out for auto-apply. Compliance requires audit log entries for any auto-change.

mike (ML): For quant recs MVP, we can ship conservative profiles + a quality delta estimate from eval harness. Need an OK on scope: do we include automatic tuning jobs or just recommendations?

jess (PM): Let's make automatic tuning a follow-up. MVP = recommendations + one-click baseline apply (manual review required). Auto-tune = alpha later.

raj (Eng): Implementation notes:
- Back-end will expose /recommendations/batching?route=... and /recommendations/quant?model=...
- Need telemetry: observed seq length distribution, qps, tail latency samples
- Caching heuristic: record prefix hit-rate and suggest TTLs
Will take ~3 sprints with 1 eng focused for API + 2 for infra + ML work.

sarah (Eng): For eval-triggered alerts: we should limit to 50 prompts at launch and run nightly. Alert types: quality regression (BLEU/ROUGE/LL?), hallucination spike, latency regressions. What metric set do we want?

mike (ML): Use a simple metric set for now: log-likelihood delta and a task-specific scoring hook (we can accept a custom evaluator function). Hallucination detection = later.

anya (Solutions): Pilot customers asked for
- explicit rollout window (canary 1% -> 10% -> 100%)
- revert button in console + audit trail
- RBAC so only tenant admins can apply recs
We should capture these as launch blockers.

lee (PM): Launch criteria (MVP):
1) End-to-end recommend -> review -> apply flow in Console (manual apply)
2) Telemetry: per-route latency + cost delta visible in Console
3) Eval alerting running nightly on pilot prompts + email + console alert
4) Audit logs for any applied recs
5) Pilot customers signed off (2 paid pilots)
If any item missing, label as 'needs gating'.

jess (PM): Prioritization notes: must-haves = Console flow, telemetry, eval alerts, audit logs, pilot signoff. Nice-to-haves = one-click auto-apply, auto-tuning, extensive hallucination detectors.

raj (Eng): Risk: automatic batch changes can increase latency for small requests if we mis-predict seq distribution. We'll add a safety guard: do not suggest higher batch sizes for routes with >20% short sequences.

sarah (Eng): Ops question: will recommendations be per-model or per-route? Hybrid recommended: per-route scoped with model-variant fallback.

mike (ML): Also include confidence score with each recommendation (high/med/low) based on data volume and eval delta. Helps UX.

anya (Solutions): Customer asks to surface estimated cost savings in dollars — can we show a rough monthly saving estimate?

raj (Eng): Yes, we can compute token-per-second and multiply by pricing profile. Estimate only; include big-font 'estimate' disclaimer.

ops-bot: Created ticket OPT-342: "Optimize toolkit MVP - recommend/apply flow + eval alerts" and linked to epic OPT-300.

jess (PM): Action items:
- raj: prototype recommendation API + safety guard (owner) — TODO by EOD Fri
- sarah: wire Console mocks for review flow + cost/latency visualization — TODO Mon
- mike: define eval metric set and provide example 50-prompt suite — TODO Wed
- anya: recruit 2 pilot customers and document compliance asks — TODO next Tue
- lee: draft launch criteria doc and acceptance checklist (I'll own acceptance doc) — TODO Thu

mike (ML): One more ask — expose per-recommendation 'test-run' mode that simulates applying recs on sampled traffic (no real apply) so customers can preview changes. Feasible?

raj (Eng): Feasible as a simulation mode offline. We'll add flag `simulate=true` on API. Not part of initial Console but could be CLI/SDK alpha.

jess (PM): Sounds good. Let's reconvene Thursday to gate. If anyone hits scope creep call it out early. :thumbsup:

anya (Solutions): noted — I'll push pilot compliance checklist after customers confirm.

lee (PM): minor: include docs note about how quant recommendations interact with Dedicated / Private deployments (KMS and binary distro constraints).

jess (PM): thanks everyone — I'll post the acceptance checklist doc link once it's ready and tag this thread.

sarah (Eng): ack.

raj (Eng): ack.

mike (ML): ack.

ops-bot: OPT-342 updated with assignees.
